header_harvest.py callees survey 2026-09-19 (user-direct-fixes-20260919): DIVERGENT ov12:RgFileSysRead, 3 TU typedef spelling vs 2 TU struct-tag spelling
RgFileSysRead.rationale: Decided with docs/header-canon.md 'How a decision is made': the owner's declaration wins over a caller's view (rule 1), it is the most-used spelling (rule 7), and the two struct-tag spellings name exactly the same types through the shared typedefs, so they carry no byte evidence (rule 0). lint now reports rg_effect_env.c and rg_bxx.c as CONFLICT RgFileSysRead until they drop the tags; converging them is codegen-neutral.

evidence: main/tu110 src/main/ssd_init.c: RssdCallFunc (main:0x0023fff0) is INCLUDE_ASM, so no generated header states its prototype; main/tu110's own src/main/ssd_init.h declares `int RssdCallFunc(int command, RssdRequest *request, void *data, int size);` and is the only spelling in the published tree

original main:0x0023fff0..0x0024012c: `sh $21,0($17)` stores the command halfword, a non-null request is copied as the 32-byte RssdRequest (four ldl/ldr -> sdl/sdr pairs), `size` bytes of `data` follow at buffer +0x20, and the sceSifCallRpc result (or -1) is returned (src/main/ssd_init.h)

callers main/tu111 (ssd_set.c), main/tu112 (ssd_1.c) and main/tu113 (ssd_2.c) read it through that header (waived foreign_local_include), all calling RssdCallFunc(command, &request, data-or-0, size-or-0)
header_harvest.py callees survey 2026-09-19 (user-direct-fixes-20260919): RssdCallFunc, one spelling (main/tu110)
RssdCallFunc.rationale: The callee is still assembly, so config/header-callees.json is its canonical home until main/tu110 publishes it in C. The text is the owner's single published spelling; RssdRequest is published by include/main/ssd_init.h, so a caller that declares RssdCallFunc locally includes that header for the type. RssdWork and RssdWorkFlags are not settled here (tu_local decision in config/header-canon.json).
RssdCallFunc.text: int RssdCallFunc(int command, RssdRequest *request, void *data, int size);
